description: This Java class is a Spring Boot REST controller for managing books in a book-tracking application. It provides endpoints for retrieving, adding, updating, and deleting books, as well as fetching book genres. It uses services for business logic and ModelMapper for object conversions.

classes.name: BookController
classes.description: Spring REST controller for managing book resources, including CRUD operations and genre retrieval.

methods.name: predefinedShelfConverter
methods.description: Converts a string to a PredefinedShelf object, resolving predefined shelf names.

methods.name: bookGenreConverter
methods.description: Converts a string to a BookGenre enum.

methods.name: bookFormatConverter
methods.description: Converts a string to a BookFormat enum.

methods.name: all
methods.description: Retrieves a list of all books, optionally paginated.

methods.name: findById
methods.description: Retrieves a book by its ID.

methods.name: addBook
methods.description: Creates a new book from the provided DTO.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates an existing book with provided patch data.

methods.name: convertToBook
methods.description: Maps a BookDto to a Book entity using ModelMapper.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes a book by its ID.
